brief: Replace literal heading-adjacent icons with intricate sculptural objects, scattered sparingly through apparently incidental whitespace. Static compositions vary by page and screen width.
optimization: WebP quality 88, same dimensions; alpha channel verified byte-for-byte against the generated PNG. No creative raster edits.

Publications: off-center in the lower masthead

assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single premium transparent-background cutout for an airy blue-grey personal portfolio. Create an intriguing physical sculpture with an unusual, asymmetric silhouette and rich, precise material detail. Mature contemporary art direction, photographed like a small museum object under soft directional studio light, slightly above three-quarter view. A coherent family of tactile colored paper and matte sculptural surfaces. All exterior pixels and open holes must be genuinely transparent, clean anti-aliased alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no detached cast shadow, no label or writing. Square canvas. Exactly ONE complete object, centered with at least 15% empty transparent margin on every side, including every point or tendril. The object should read beautifully at 130–240px on pale blue-grey #edf2f6. Saturated warm color only, controlled natural tonal depth. No beige, brown, gold metal, glass, glowing effects, gradient blobs, stock 3D UI icons, emoji, simple torus, literal math symbol, spheres-and-rods diagram, base or pedestal. No props.

Subject: a surprising, elegant paper structure made from ONE continuous thin vermilion-orange sheet. The sheet turns through a loose, uneven open curl; one side splits into many very fine accordion fins that fan out irregularly, and the other tapers into a long sharp, gracefully curling tail. Somewhere between an unfurling living frond, a wind-shaped flame, and an architectural paper experiment. The folds vary in spacing and depth and reveal slivers of saffron on a few inner edges. The silhouette is diagonal, elongated, air-filled and expressive, with an off-center void and a delicate interruption in its rhythm. Deep saturated vermilion #ff4a24 and tangerine #ff8725, tiny sun-yellow edges. Real paper fiber and exceptionally crisp folds. No regular closed ring and no symmetrical flower.

placements: Home: breathing room between portrait and publications
Other generic project pages: offset above the closing link

Subject: an asymmetric, partly opened seed-like volume constructed from a very thin saffron-yellow sheet with intricate fan pleats. The sheet has been folded, curled and gently torn into a strange organic form: one broad ribbed lobe curls around a large empty opening, a smaller lobe folds inward, and a slender irregular pointed tendril escapes to one side. Beautiful structural tension between sharp folds and supple curves. The orientation is tilted and the mass is uneven, like a specimen from an imagined botanical collection rather than a familiar leaf or flower. Sun-yellow #ffc52c with saturated golden-orange #ff9b20 in the deeper folds; dry matte paper, finely visible fibers, glowing only through natural thin-paper translucency. Strong sophisticated silhouette, substantial dimensional depth. No round ball, radial rosette, chrysanthemum, recognizable ginkgo leaf, or simple fan.

placements: Projects: upper-right open space above the first category

Subject: an extraordinary small vermilion sculpture shaped like a thin, crumpled, porous organic membrane. A lopsided folded saddle arches around negative space, with a hierarchy of irregular oval and elongated cellular openings through its skin. Some edges are knife-thin and lifted; one narrow section curls outward into an unexpected pointed hook. Think a physically plausible porous coral fragment meeting an experimental architectural surface, finely crafted, intricate, with clear large openings and a few delicate branching struts. Entire structure is ONE connected object, broad on one side and tapered on the other, not spherical and not symmetrical. Saturated scarlet-vermilion #ff3b24, subtle tangerine on a few thin edges, matte mineral / paper-porcelain texture. Rich self-shadow within the openings, no black cavities painted onto surfaces: all holes show true transparency. Avoid an obvious coral tree, neuron icon, rounded cheese, rock, crumpled ball, octopus, honeycomb grid, regular lattice cube or generic 3D knot.
